subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: After the P1 blockers are fixed, should #102261 remain one exceptional 191-file interactive-parity PR or be split into staged question, plan, and goal PRs?
rationale: VISION.md sets a one-topic PR expectation and says PRs over roughly 5,000 changed lines are exceptional, while this branch intentionally bundles three major interaction primitives plus UI/channel/protocol/config changes.

options.title: Split into staged PRs
options.body: Land question infrastructure first, then plan mode, then goal mode with separate proof and rollback points.

options.title: Grant one exceptional merge review
options.body: Keep the branch intact but require explicit maintainer ownership of the cross-surface compatibility, security, and proof risks.

options.title: Pause until a narrower scope is chosen
options.body: Keep the roadmap issue open and close or supersede this PR if maintainers do not want the bundled rollout.

recommendation.title: Split into staged PRs
recommendation.body: Land question infrastructure first, then plan mode, then goal mode with separate proof and rollback points.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects Vincent Koc to the SDK, Slack, config, and UI surfaces touched by this bundled PR.
